text: Oh i see the problem. you need to set the width of this panel to be at minimum the width of your content. i dont want to horizontal scroll
resolution: Panel field clipping fix: rows-layout groups kept the base flexWrap:'wrap' while switching to flexDirection:column, so fields spilled into a second column past the fixed 290px props panel and were only reachable by horizontal scroll. Forced flexWrap:'nowrap' on rows groups in shell/fields.tsx so fields always stack vertically, and widened PropsCol 290→360 in shell/workbench.cls.ts. Shared across all workbench panels (all are stack-intended).
